corpus_staging.notes: Per user directive 2026-07-31: L0-L2 may use the bounded synthetic-English fixture from W10-11 for wiring, signal-trace, and probe noninterference checks only. No causal, efficiency, likelihood-ratio, or bypass claim may be derived from that fixture. L3+ requires a vendored real-English public-domain corpus with authenticated partition manifest; the held-out test partition remains sealed until thresholds, reaction coordinates, and evidence criteria are locked at L3-L10.

L1.summary: Authoritative signal trace on HybridModel.forward via optional BypassProbe. Default forward-path bit-identical.

L2.summary: Visible barrier registry (aeon/bypass/barriers.py + benchmarks/latent_bypass/barriers.json). Metrics operate on visible data only. Thresholds calibrated on calibration partition, locked before evaluation.

L3.summary: Hidden reaction-coordinate framework (norm / directional / predictive). Fit on calibration only, evaluated held-out.

L4.summary: Bounded bypass telemetry per sampled window; sub-10% overhead target, 15% hard ceiling.

L6.summary: English barrier benchmark set (long-range entity, delayed instructions, pronoun resolution, nested dependency, contradiction, state tracking, aliasing, negation).

L7.summary: Cost and matched-control campaign; net-efficiency accounting.

L8.summary: Latent-state inference: held-out M0 vs M1 comparison with matched-capacity and shuffled-state controls.

L9.summary: Full-loop stability analysis; separate structural, projection, response, and empirical bounds.

L10.summary: Integrated bypass decision under all six existence conditions.

L11.summary: Closure report + final claim level. Jumping levels forbidden.
